docs.summary: Serializes and deserializes dock layouts to/from JSON strings. No file I/O or project dependencies - the host handles persistence. Panel types are stored by full type name; the host provides a factory delegate to reconstruct them on load.
Serialize the dock layout to a JSON string.

members.name: Deserialize
members.signature: public static DockNode? Deserialize(string json, List<FloatingWindow> floatingWindows, Func<string, JsonObject?, DockPanel?> panelFactory)

docs.summary: Deserialize a JSON string into a dock layout. Populates floatingWindows and returns the root node. The panelFactory resolves type name strings to DockPanel instances.
